description: Answers 'is anything overdue?' Lists past due items from the last 45 days that still need action, with the course name and the date each was due. Input: course_ids, an optional array of course IDs to limit the list; leave it out to cover all current courses. Ask: 'Is anything overdue?'

items.description: Moodle course ID. Use get_my_courses to find it.

title: Overdue work
